blocks.text: Chiclayo and the Lord of Sipán – Lima

provenance.rationale: Concise route heading identifying the same museum visit and onward flight as the approved Word day.

blocks.text: Day 13 · Breakfast and a day devoted to one of the most fascinating chapters of Peruvian history. Begin at the museum of the Lord of Sipán, which displays the treasures found in the tomb of this great Moche ruler, often called “the Tutankhamun of Peru”: gold and silver ornaments, ceremonial masks and ritual objects. Continue to Huaca Rajada, the archaeological complex among sand and adobe pyramids where the tomb was discovered, and its site museum, which places the discovery in context. Lunch and a taste of northern Peruvian cuisine, then flight to Lima and transfer to the hotel.
